text:
samira: heads up — I need to swap primary for tonight. I need to leave early for a doctor's appt, can @alex take primary from 18:00 -> 02:00 PST? I’ll stay secondary until 21:30 then go offline. I’ll leave handoff notes below. :wave:

alex: cc @samira — I can take primary, but I have a 20:15-20:45 meeting (should be on my calendar). would appreciate someone to shadow during that window in case pages stack. I’ll add myself to PagerDuty and update the rota. :thumbsup:

jordan: I can cover the 20:15-20:45 slot if needed. will keep phone on and watch the alert channel. if a major page happens ping me directly. :telephone_receiver:

priya: quick checklist I want us to confirm before samira signs out: 1) PagerDuty primary set to alex, 2) Canary traffic route healthy, 3) run healthcheck on production model pool, 4) confirm failover plan for Latin region. Also left a short snippet from the runbook and the minimal commands below.

incident-bot: :rotating_light: Scheduled pager test in 45 minutes (19:00 UTC). This is a test — will page all on-duty primaries. If you do not want the test to reach your phone, update your PD contact method.

samira: copying runbook excerpt and manual checks — follow these in order and mark done in thread if you run them:

```
Runbook: Evening handoff (condensed)
- Set PagerDuty primary to: alex (check PD web UI)
- Post a one-line status in #incidents: "primary=alex secondary=samira (samira out @21:30)"
- Canary: curl -sS https://canary.internal.redwood/health || alert
- Model pool check: ./tools/pool-check --region=us-west-2 --model=redwood-1
- KV cache: nvtop or `nvidia-smi` to ensure <85% mem on primary nodes
- If sustained latency >2s for 2+ min: flip-route to model-variant-b with `routectl promote model-variant-b`
- Escalation: page @jordan if PD auto-escalation fails
```

samira: also: calendar invite sent to alex + jordan. I pushed a short note into the runbook page: https://internal.redwood.com/runbooks/handbook/handoff-evening (please upload any edits)

alex: confirmed — I set myself as primary in PD and posted the status in #incidents. I ran the canary curl and got 200 OK from three instances. nvml shows one GPU at 78% mem, others below 60%.

jordan: I’ll be reachable on +1-555-842-0003 during that 20:15 window. will monitor alerts and jump in if anything noisy shows up.

priya: small note — there’s a background deploy in staging tonight at 22:30 but not prod. but if the staging deploy triggers any integrated tests that hit shared infra we might see transient noise. flagging it here so primary doesn’t get confused by noise.

oncall-rotations: rotation update: primary=alex (1800123456-180012... ), secondary=samira. Reminder: verify coverage in the APAC handover tomorrow morning.

alex: thanks all. I’ll stay glued to the channel until 02:00 PST. samira — have a good appointment. jordan — appreciate the shadow. marking checklist done as I complete items. :white_check_mark:

samira: thanks team — leaving thread in case anything changes. I’ll check DMs if escalation needed before 21:30. :pray:
